bio.text: Rashida Tlaib represents Michigan's 12th Congressional District, which includes Detroit, Dearborn, Southfield and surrounding communities, in the U.S. House of Representatives.
She was born and raised in Detroit, the oldest of 14 children of Palestinian immigrant parents.
In 2008 she became the first Muslim woman to serve in the Michigan Legislature.
She worked as an attorney at the Sugar Law Center for Economic and Social Justice and serves on the House Committees on Financial Services and Oversight and Accountability.
